description: This is a test class for the CameraHandler component, containing unit tests for the method isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit and a constant CAMERA_CLIP_MAX_RAW_BYTES.

classes.name: CameraHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class for CameraHandler, with tests verifying the behavior of payload size limits.

methods.name: isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit_allowsZeroAndLimit
methods.description: Tests that the function allows zero and maximum allowed raw bytes.

methods.name: isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit_rejectsNegativeAndTooLarge
methods.description: Tests that the function rejects negative values and values exceeding the maximum limit.

methods.name: cameraClipMaxRawBytes_matchesExpectedBudget
methods.description: Verifies that CAMERA_CLIP_MAX_RAW_BYTES matches the expected size of 18MB.
